Method.name: OnTask
Method.Description: The OnTask() method is called to execute the task
Method.Implementation:
set tSC = $$$OK set $NAMESPACE = "EDIPAYER"
set fileNm = $ZSTRIP(..outputFile _ "-" _ $ZDATETIME($ZTIMESTAMP,8,1,2) _ ".txt", "*W")
Set outFile=##class(%File).%New(fileNm)
Do outFile.Open("WSN") Do outFile.WriteLine( " TP import Run Time: " _ $ZDATETIME($ZTIMESTAMP,8,1,2) _ " on " _$SYSTEM)
set cmd = ..TpImportScript if (..ImportFromEdifecs =1) { Do ..ReadFromEdifecs(cmd, outFile) } Do ..ImportTradingPartners(..TpImportDirec _ "TradingPartners.txt", outFile, ..LastModifiedDate) Do ..ImportTPIDs(..TpImportDirec _ "TpIds.txt", outFile, ..LastModifiedDate) Do ..ImportTranTypes(..TpImportDirec _ "TRANSACTIONTYPES.txt", outFile) Do ..ImportTpLinks(..TpImportDirec _ "tpLinks-IRIS.txt", outFile, ..LastModifiedDate)
return tSC

Method.name: ReadFromEdifecs
ImportTradingPartners
ImportTPIDs
ImportTranTypes
ImportTpLinks
